### GT save function

```{r portal-plot, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}
library(cbbplotR)
library(rlang)

# save function 
gt_save_crop <- function(data, file = NULL, bg = "white", whitespace = 50, zoom = 2, expand = 5) {
  tmp <- tempfile(fileext = ".png")
  
  # Wrap the gtsave_extra call in a tryCatch to handle errors
  tryCatch({
    gtExtras::gtsave_extra(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  }, error = function(e) {
    # If there's an error, try using regular gt::gtsave instead
    message("gtsave_extra failed, trying gt::gtsave...")
    gt::gtsave(data, tmp, zoom = zoom, expand = expand)
  })
  
  magick::image_read(tmp) |> 
    magick::image_trim() |> 
    magick::image_border(bg, glue::glue('{whitespace}x{whitespace}')) |> 
    magick::image_write(file)
  unlink(tmp)
}

```

### Arm barn

```{r arm-barn, warning=FALSE, message=FALSE}

uncpitch <- readr::read_csv("unc-pitch.csv", show_col_types = FALSE) |>
  dplyr::mutate(date = as.Date(date, format = "%m/%d/%y"))

# Convert baseball innings notation directly to whole outs
# 5 innings = 15 outs, 6.2 = 20 outs, 4.1 = 13 outs
to_outs <- function(x) {
  whole <- floor(x)
  extra <- round((x - whole) * 10)  # .1 = 1 out, .2 = 2 outs
  as.integer(whole * 3 + extra)
}

monthly <- uncpitch |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    outs_game = to_outs(innings),
    month     = lubridate::floor_date(date, "month")
  ) |>
  dplyr::group_by(player, month) |>
  dplyr::summarise(
    outs    = sum(outs_game),
    pitches = sum(pitches),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    # Convert back to display innings: 20 outs = 6.2, 13 outs = 4.1
    innings_whole = outs %/% 3L,
    innings_extra = outs %%  3L,
    innings = dplyr::if_else(
      innings_extra == 0L,
      as.character(innings_whole),
      paste0(innings_whole, ".", innings_extra)
    ),
    p_per_out = round(pitches / outs, 2),
    month     = format(month, "%B")
  ) |>
  dplyr::select(player, month, innings, outs, pitches, p_per_out)


unc_header <-glue::glue(
  "<div style='display: flex; justify-content: space-between; align-items: center;'>
      <div>
       <img src='https://a.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=/i/teamlogos/ncaa/500/153.png'
       style='height: 55px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
     <div style='flex-grow:1; margin-left: 30px; margin-right: 30px'>
       <span style='display: block; font-weight: bold; text-align: center; font-size: 24px;'>Carolina's Arm Barn <br>efficiency by month</span>
       <span style='font-size: 14px; font-weight: normal; display: block; text-align: center;'>Shows total innings, pitches, and pitches per out by month for Carolina's four primary pitchers.</span>
     </div>
       <div>
       <img src='https://a3.espncdn.com/combiner/i?img=%2Fredesign%2Fassets%2Fimg%2Ficons%2FESPN%2Dicon%2Dbaseball.png'
       style='height: 45px; width: auto; vertical-align: middle;'>
     </div>
      
   </div>
  <br>"
)

monthly |> 
dplyr::mutate(
  month = factor(month, levels = c("May", "April", "March", "February"))
) |>
  dplyr::arrange(month, p_per_out) |> 
dplyr::group_by(month) |> 
  gt::gt() |> 
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |> 
  gt::cols_label(
    player = "",
    innings = "Innings",
    outs = "Outs",
    pitches = "Pitches",
    p_per_out = "P/O"
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(unc_header)) |> 
  gt::tab_style(
    style = list(gt::cell_borders(
      sides = c("left", "right", "top", "bottom"),
      color = "black",
      weight = gt::px(2)  
    )),
    locations = list(
      gt::cells_body(),
      gt::cells_column_labels(),
      gt::cells_row_groups()
    )
  ) |> 
  gt::data_color(
    columns = c(p_per_out),
    direction = c("column"),
    method = c("numeric"),
    palette = c("#d7191c", "#fdae61", "#ffffbf", "#a6d96a", "#1a9641"),
    domain = c(4.5, 7),
    alpha = 0.6,
    reverse = TRUE
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_source_note(
    source_note =
      gt::html(
        "<hr>P/O means pitches per out. <br>Data through May 24 games  via goheels.com + statbroadcast.com <br>
        Excludes any other pitching statistics on purpose, the goal is to surface usage and efficiency<br>
        <hr><b>Table by Chris at Bless your chart</b>"
      )
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_options(table.width = gt::px(455)) |> 
  gtUtils::gt_border_bars_bottom(c("#56a0d3", "#89BDE0",
                                   "#BBD9ED")) -> nc_tbl 

gt_save_crop(
  nc_tbl,
  file = "nc_tbl.png",
  whitespace = 40,
  bg = "white"
) 

nc_tbl
```

ncaa_b <- readr::read_csv("ncaa_b.csv")

ncaab_tbl <- ncaa_b |>
  dplyr::mutate(across(where(is.character), ~ tidyr::replace_na(.x, ""))) |>
  dplyr::mutate(
    sec_1 = "",
    sec_col = paste0(sec_t1, " ", sec_t2),
    sec_blank = "", 
    acc_col = paste0(acc_t1, " ", acc_t2),
    acc_blank = "",
    bigtw_col = paste0(bigtw_t1, " ", bigtw_t2),
    bigtw_blank = "",
    sun_col = paste0(sun_t1, " ", sun_t2),
    sun_blank = "",
    big_col = paste0(bigten_t1, " ", bigten_t2),
    big_blank = ""
  ) |> 
  dplyr::mutate(across(ends_with("_col"), ~ dplyr::case_when(
    .x == " " ~ "<span></span>",
    .x == "NA NA" ~ "<span></span>",
    .x == "" ~ "<span></span>",
    TRUE ~ .x
  ))) |>
  dplyr::select(
    sec_1, sec_col, sec_blank,
    acc_col, acc_blank,
    bigtw_col, bigtw_blank,
    sun_col, sun_blank,
    big_col, big_blank
  ) |> 
  gt::gt() |>
  gtUtils::gt_theme_savant() |> 
  gt::fmt_markdown(columns = ends_with("_col")) |> 
  gt::cols_align(
    align = "center",
    columns = gt::everything()
  ) |> 
  gt::tab_header(title = gt::html(baseball_header)) |>
  gt::tab_source_note(source_note = gt::html("<hr><b>Multi-bid leagues</b><br>

      <b>Sun Belt (5 bids, 14 teams)</b>: Coastal Carolina, Louisiana, Southern Mississippi, Texas State, Troy | <span style='color: #888888;'><s>South Alabama, App State, ODU, Georgia St., Marshall, Arkansas St., ULM, James Madison, Ga. Southern</s></span><br>
      <b>Big Ten (4 bids, 17 teams)</b>: Nebraska, Oregon, USC, UCLA | <span style='color: #888888;'><s>Purdue, Ohio St., Michigan, Iowa, Illinois, Rutgers, Washington, Minnesota, Michigan St., Indiana, Maryland, Penn St., Northwestern</s></span><br>
